head: 59c173d57eab763ec118110a2d5377c7e228c9d8
claim: A Pi consumer on a computer gets an ollama-pro model from the engine and calls Ollama Pro through a loopback stub with no local alias

steps.start: Worktree at commit 59c173d5 on fm/byk-oc-ollama-call-shape, clean, built with npm run build; no Ollama Pro plan key saved; loopback stub not yet running.
steps: Ran the build and the doctor check that @byokit/accounts resolves inside packages/accounts/dist.
Wrote a Node consumer in a scratch folder that imports only public entries (@byokit/accounts, @byokit/accounts/ollama-pro) with an in-memory key store.
Asked the computer engine for the ollama-pro model 'deepseek-v4.1-flash' with no local alias and printed the model's provider, API shape and base URL.
Asked the Ollama Pro plan-key account for a model before any key was saved; the consumer printed the refusal.
Added the Ollama Pro plan key to the Accounts instance (the key is stored, never printed).
Started a loopback HTTP stub on 127.0.0.1 standing in for https://ollama.com/v1.
Sent a chat request through accounts.respondKey using the engine's model, with fetch redirected from https://ollama.com to the loopback stub.
Read back what the stub received (path, model, stream flag, whether the bearer matched the saved key) and the reply, and checked the key was absent from the result.
Ran the consumer to completion; the transcript is saved as ollama-pro-engine-call.txt.
steps.result: The transcript shows the engine returns an ollama-pro model (provider ollama-pro, openai-completions, base URL https://ollama.com/v1) with no alias; the plan-key account refuses with 'Add the Ollama Pro plan key first.' before a key is saved; after saving, the loopback stub receives POST /v1/chat/completions with the deepseek-v4.1-flash model, stream true and the saved key as Bearer, and the consumer gets stopReason stop with text pong-from-stub; the key does not appear in the result.

verdicts.seen: I read every entry in the capture (about 10 lines). It shows engine.getModel returning provider=ollama-pro, api=openai-completions, baseUrl=https://ollama.com/v1. Before the key was saved, the request was refused with 'Add the Ollama Pro plan key first.' The plan key was then saved as account ollama-pro:plan_key. The chat went through a loopback stub, with request URL https://ollama.com/v1/chat/completions, and the stub saw model=deepseek-v4.1-flash, stream=true, and bearer-matches-saved-key=true. The reply was stopReason=stop with text 'pong-from-stub', and canary in result was false. This matches the outcome: a Pi consumer with no local alias gets the ollama-pro model from the engine and calls Ollama Pro through a loopback stub.
